Object outputs are compared only with canonical object branches, so null/primitive union arms cannot admit a stale object return. Zero-argument responders remain supported. trpcError and trpcHold remain supported. malformedOrForwardTrpcWire is the only named malformed/forward-version escape.
routeTrpc.sourceCompatibility: No call-site wrapper is required. Empty and wholly nonoverlapping legacy placeholder objects remain accepted; once a fixture models any canonical object field, all of its keys are checked against that canonical branch. Canonical arrays are checked against array branches.
